title: Unitaria: Quantum Linear Algebra via Block Encodings
summary: We introduce Unitaria, a Python library that brings the simplicity of classical linear algebra toolkits such as NumPy and SciPy to the implementation of quantum algorithms based on block encodings, a general-purpose abstraction in which a matrix is embedded as a sub-block of a larger unitary operator. Their implementation has so far required deep knowledge of low-level circuit construction, which Unitaria aims to eliminate. The library provides a composable, array-like interface through which users can define block encodings of matrices and vectors, combine them through standard operations…
